summary: Confirmed 30A/water and phone reservations on the operator's site. Cleared derived site count, pull-through and year_round:false (operator silent). Kept the note's other details, labelled as directory-sourced. No rate posted anywhere.
flags: GATE FACTS: no rate on the operator's site and no booking engine ('Call us now and reserve your spot'). RV Life 4*/$$ (stored tier 2, the only price signal); no dated camper rate found. Good Sam: not a GS Park (stored false). No gateway within 40 km (Point Pelee 103 km). GOOGLE MAPS: 4.6 from 175 reviews, phone 419-585-3331 matches the site. Not a family stay.

LONG-STAY TESTS 2 AND 4, for a human decision: the park looks long-stay in character. Leaf-off imagery shows tightly packed, settled-looking units in rows, some with sheds or other structures. Its own words: 'close-knit community atmosphere', 'family-friendly community environment'. Secondary signs: Campendium lists a monthly rate, the non-operator archive site lists daily, weekly, monthly and seasonal camping, and a Google review mentions a third generation camping there. If it is long-stay, it has no posted nightly rate, so it fails test 2 and the RV Life tier does not stand in. Its nightly share is not published, so test 4 is unknown. A phone call would settle both.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (stored lakefront, looks unearned for most sites; my read of imagery, not measured on the ground): the fishing lake runs along the camp's NW edge. Most units are east of the camp road, roughly 40-300 m from the bank, with a large building and the swim pond between them and the lake's south part. Closest units I can see: a few near the lake's NE arm (about 20 m) and a few at the west end of the south row, just below the lake's SW tip (about 15-40 m). The operator says only 'relax by our beautiful lake' and 'beautiful lake right on the grounds'.

WEBSITE TRAP: Google Maps lists clintonlakecamping.com, which is NOT the operator: 'This site keeps the old Clinton Lake Camping website on record... Clinton Lake Camping does not run it, and it cannot take reservations'. The stored https://www.clintonlakeohiocamping.com/ is right (live, © 2026, phone and address).
